{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
df_complete = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Print the number of missing values in each column
print("Missing values in flipper_length_mm:", df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())
print("Missing values in body_mass_g:", df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum())

# Print the number of complete cases
print("Number of complete cases:", len(df_complete))

# Compute Pearson correlation on complete cases
corr = df_complete['flipper_length_mm'].corr(df_complete['body_mass_g'])
print("Pearson correlation coefficient:", corr)"}
